Class CharacterFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.card.CharacterFactory
public class CharacterFactory extends Object
Factory that deserializes a CharacterCard (with the appropriate CharacterEffect) from a Jackson JsonNode.

Uses an internal registry that maps each CharacterType to a lambda responsible for constructing the corresponding effect from JSON parameters.
